<h2>Research and data</h2><p><strong>Czechoslovak Foreign Trade: Interwar Dataset.</strong> Annual national and bilateral data, 1920–1938; monthly national data, 1924–1938. <a href="czechoslovak-foreign-trade.html">Dataset</a>.</p><p><strong>Czechoslovakia’s Effective Exchange Rates, 1920–1938.</strong> Annual indices, weights and coverage. <a href="czechoslovakia-eer.html">Dataset</a> · <a href="https://doi.org/10.3886/E251023V1">Related replication deposit</a>.</p>
<div class="cv-entry">
<div class="cv-date">GDP reconstruction</div>
<div>Sector-by-sector reconstruction of interwar Czechoslovak GDP at current and constant prices, developed in dialogue with Matthias Morys and Marcin Wroński on comparative Central and Eastern European national accounts. <a href="research.html#czechoslovak-gdp">Project description.</a></div>
</div>
<div class="cv-entry">
<div class="cv-date">Agricultural output</div>
<div>Preliminary reconstruction of crop and livestock output and agricultural gross value added, 1920–1937, using commodity quantities, prices and intermediate inputs. Agricultural paper in preparation; first developed component of the GDP project.</div>
</div>
<div class="cv-entry">
<div class="cv-date">Monetary history</div>
<div>Reconstruction of monthly Czechoslovak monetary and macroeconomic series from National Bank reports, 1926–1938, alongside comparative European sources.</div>
</div>
<div class="cv-entry">
<div class="cv-date">Open research</div>
<div>Public datasets on Czechoslovak financial stress and monthly European exchange-rate and trade-balance adjustment (The Missing J, 1925–1936). <a href="data.html">Data and replication packages.</a></div>
</div>

<div class="cv-date">Manuscripts</div>
<div>Current research on monetary defence, devaluation, trade adjustment, historical national accounts, healthcare and Czech economic thought. <a href="publications.html#research-manuscripts">Current manuscripts and papers in preparation.</a></div>

<p>Historical source criticism; archival, parliamentary and press research; central-bank balance-sheet reconstruction; index construction and decomposition; time-series and panel econometrics; PPML and gravity models; event studies; synthetic control and comparative counterfactual analysis.</p>
